author: Megan  Cerullo
title: Moody's downgrades U.S. credit rating, citing rising government debt - CBS News
description: Moody's lowered its rating on U.S. debt from Aaa to Aa1, pointing to sustained increase in federal debt and interest payments.
content_summary: Moody's has downgraded the U.S. credit rating from Aaa to Aa1 due to significant federal debt growth and interest payment increases over the past decade, outpacing similarly rated countries. Despite political disputes over causes, the U.S. retains economic strengths including its global reserve currency status and effective monetary policy. This downgrade signals ongoing fiscal challenges and growing deficits projected to reach 9% of GDP by 2035.

author: https://gothamist.com/staff/ramsey-khalifeh
title: NJ Transit rail service shuts down as workers go on historic strike - Gothamist
description: Commuters were due for disaster Friday morning as roughly 450 locomotive engineers who operate NJ Transit's trains went on strike.
content_summary: NJ Transit rail service, serving over 100,000 weekday riders, was shut down following a strike by 450 locomotive engineers demanding better pay after no raises since 2019. This is New Jersey's first major transit strike since 1983, forcing commuters to seek alternative transportation options amid warnings of overcrowding. The strike highlights financial constraints of the transit agency and ongoing labor disputes.

author: Kristina Partsinevelos, Chris Eudaily
title: Nvidia, Cisco, Oracle and OpenAI are backing the UAE Stargate data center project - CNBC
description: President Donald Trump traveled to the United Arab Emirates as part of his first state visit abroad in his second term. Trump also visited Saudi Arabia.
content_summary: U.S. tech giants Nvidia, Cisco, Oracle, and OpenAI are supporting the UAE Stargate AI data center project in Abu Dhabi, which will feature a 5-gigawatt campus. The project builds on a similar U.S. initiative announced by President Trump, who recently visited UAE and Saudi Arabia. This collaboration marks a significant expansion of AI infrastructure and international technology partnerships in the Middle East.

author: Sheena Vasani
title: REIs anniversary sale is dropping prices on Garmins and other great outdoor gear - The Verge
description: REIs anniversary sale includes deals on a number of our favorite outdoor gadgets, including Garmin watches, the InReach Mini 2, LifeStraw filters, and more.
content_summary: REI's anniversary sale offers up to 30% off outdoor gear including Garmin smartwatches, satellite communicators, and camping equipment such as water filters and stoves. The sale runs through May 26 and provides significant savings for outdoor enthusiasts preparing for summer activities. Key product highlights include the Garmin Forerunner series and the Fenix 8, known for advanced tracking and battery life.

author: Fred Lambert
title: Teslas robotaxi fleet will be powered by plenty of teleoperation - Electrek
description: Teslas Austin robotaxi fleet will be powered by plenty of teleoperation as it cant screw up, according to a new...
content_summary: Tesla plans to launch a robotaxi service in Austin deploying 10-20 vehicles using Supervised Full Self-Driving tech combined with teleoperation, allowing employees to remotely control cars for safety. This approach addresses current autonomous tech limitations, ensuring high safety standards. Launch is expected in June 2025. The move highlights both progress and ongoing challenges in autonomous vehicle deployment.
